item.title: Thursday Morning, Oct 29
item.description:
The Thursday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for October 29, 2026: the full New York City forecast with the week ahead; Judge Carter rejects the Justice Department's bid to set aside twenty thousand California ballots, and both parties make closing midterm pitches; Spain's train-crash toll rises to sixty-nine with focus on a control-center order, Israel awaits final results, Semafor reports parallel tracks of Iran diplomacy and post-midterm strike planning, a deadly Russian strike on Dnipro's train station, and Christine Lagarde's early exit from the ECB; markets in depth as Alphabet sinks and Microsoft rises ahead of inflation and GDP data; Anduril and Qualcomm's U.S.-assembled BlueChip laptop; OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra and Google DeepMind's Genie 4; Cisco's exploited firewall flaw, an attack on Alpine Linux's GitLab and GitHub's new npm firewall; your X feed; a deadly e-scooter fire in the Bronx, vandalism at the 9/11 Memorial and a huge weekend in the city; and a soup kitchen that opened a free dental clinic. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
